lead.h: Good to see you: workplace messaging switches over to the assistant's grammar
p: From this week the short phrases the assistant likes have begun to appear in the internal messages of many companies. Linguists call it "the language of efficiency". Asked what "One step at a time" means, three managers gave three different answers.
A fourth manager answered: it means what it says.
